description: This source file implements packet handling functions used in Git's transport protocol. It manages packet formatting, transmission, reception, and sideband demultiplexing, facilitating communication in Git's protocol over network streams or file descriptors.

methods.name: void packet_trace_identity(const char * prog)
methods.description: Sets the packet trace prefix to a specific program name, duplicating the string.

methods.name: const char * get_trace_prefix(void)
methods.description: Returns the current trace prefix, switching to 'sideband' if in asynchronous mode.

methods.name: int packet_trace_pack(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int sideband)
methods.description: Handles trace logging for pack data based on sideband.

methods.name: void packet_trace(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int write)
methods.description: Logs packet data with a prefix indicating direction and content, handling special cases like PACK markers.

methods.name: void packet_flush(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a flush packet ('0000') over the specified file descriptor.

methods.name: void packet_delim(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a delimiter packet ('0001') over the specified file descriptor.

methods.name: void packet_response_end(int fd)
methods.description: Sends a response end packet ('0002') over the specified file descriptor.

methods.name: int packet_flush_gently(int fd)
methods.description: Attempts to flush a packet gently, returns error status if it fails.

methods.name: void packet_buf_flush(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a flush packet to a strbuf.

methods.name: void packet_buf_delim(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a delimiter packet to a strbuf.

methods.name: void set_packet_header(char * buf,int size)
methods.description: Encodes packet size into the first 4 bytes of a buffer in hexadecimal.

methods.name: void format_packet(struct strbuf * out,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Formats a packet with a prefix and payload, adding a header based on size.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_1(int fd,int gently,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Writes formatted data as a packet, optionally gentle error handling.

methods.name: void packet_write_fmt(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes formatted data as a packet to a file descriptor.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_gently(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes formatted data as a packet to a file descriptor, handling errors gently.

methods.name: int do_packet_write(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Handles the actual writing of a packet, including header and data.

methods.name: int packet_write_gently(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a packet forcibly, reports error on failure.

methods.name: void packet_write(int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a packet, aborting on failure.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite(FILE * f,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite_fmt(FILE * fh,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_fflush(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream with a flush packet.

methods.name: void packet_buf_write(struct strbuf * buf,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Adds a formatted packet to a strbuf.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_fd_no_flush(int fd_in,int fd_out)
methods.description: Reads data from one file descriptor and packetizes it to another without flushing.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_buf_no_flush_count(const char * src_in,size_t len,int fd_out,int * packet_counter)
methods.description: Packetizes a buffer to a file descriptor, counting packets.

methods.name: int get_packet_data(int fd,char ** src_buf,size_t * src_size,void * dst,size_t size,int options)
methods.description: Reads packet data from a file descriptor or buffer into memory, handling errors.

methods.name: int packet_length(const char lenbuf_hex[4],size_t size)
methods.description: Decodes a 4-byte hexadecimal length buffer into an integer.

methods.name: char * find_packfile_uri_path(const char * buffer)
methods.description: Parses and extracts a URI path from a packfile buffer, redacting sensitive info.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_read_with_status(int fd,char ** src_buffer,size_t * src_len,char * buffer,unsigned size,int * pktlen,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet with detailed status, handling special lengths and sideband objects.

methods.name: int packet_read(int fd,char * buffer,unsigned size,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet, returning its length.

methods.name: char * packet_read_line(int fd,int * dst_len)
methods.description: Reads a line packet, returning the line buffer.

methods.name: int packet_read_line_gently(int fd,int * dst_len,char ** dst_line)
methods.description: Reads a line packet gently, allowing EOF or error recovery.

methods.name: ssize_t read_packetized_to_strbuf(int fd_in,struct strbuf * sb_out,int options)
methods.description: Reads packetized data from a file descriptor into a strbuf.

methods.name: int recv_sideband(const char * me,int in_stream,int out)
methods.description: Receives and demultiplexes sideband packets from input stream, directing primary payload to output.

methods.name: void packet_reader_init(struct packet_reader * reader,int fd,char * src_buffer,size_t src_len,int options)
methods.description: Initializes a packet_reader structure with specified parameters.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_read(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads the next packet from the stream into the reader, handling sideband if enabled.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_peek(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Peeks at the next packet without consuming it.

methods.name: void packet_writer_init(struct packet_writer * writer,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Initializes a packet_writer with a destination file descriptor.

methods.name: void packet_writer_write(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet to the writer's output.

methods.name: void packet_writer_error(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes an error message as a packet.

methods.name: void packet_writer_delim(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Writes a delimiter packet.

methods.name: void packet_writer_flush(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Flushes the writer's packets.
